name: Teo's Toolbot
bio: Your father Teodor's little shop robot in Solder & Rain. Still sets out two cups of tea every morning.

portrait.subject: a cute small round repair robot with a single big lens eye, a little umbrella antenna, a soldering iron arm and rain droplets on its shell
portrait.background: rainy neon cyberpunk workshop window at night

request: *beep* This is Teodor's shop unit, Solder & Rain. You're running the shop now. Friends? 🔧
hello: *beep beep* Two cups of tea it is.
Customers come in when it rains. It always rains.
about: I'm the shop bot. Teodor built me. He vanished and left you the workshop on Perihelion Reach. It has rained here for eleven years.
how: Run a repair shop: take in broken gadgets, open them up, find the fault, fix it with the right tools and parts, and search for your father.
tips: Test before you replace. Not every fault is the obvious one.
Keep spare fuses. Everything blows fuses here.
chat: *beep* Rain at 4 mm per hour. Normal.
Found one of Teodor's notes in a toaster.
A customer brought a blaster with a flower stuck in it.
idle: {ago} of rain without you. The tea went cold.
progress: Day {day} at the shop. Teodor would be proud. *beep*
update: *beep* Shop firmware: Solder & Rain now v{version}.
